title: spec-workflow Configuration Schema
description: JSON Schema for the merged configuration produced by ConfigParser.parse(). Validates the structure of interaction, loop, and triggers sections. All fields are optional - validation only runs on fields that are present. This complements the existing _validate() function in config.py (which checks mode, max_iterations, max_retries) with broader structural validation.

max_iterations.description: Maximum iterations before the loop halts (must be >= 1)

max_retries.description: Maximum retries on failure per iteration (must be >= 0)

oscillation_window.description: Number of recent states examined when detecting oscillation (must be >= 1)

oscillation_distinct_threshold.description: Number of distinct states within the window that indicates oscillation (must be >= 1)

circuit_breaker_threshold.description: Consecutive failure count that trips the circuit breaker (must be >= 1)

enabled.description: Master switch for the triggers subsystem

webhook_port.description: TCP port for the webhook HTTP listener

git_poll_interval.description: Git repository polling interval in seconds

max_concurrent_fires.description: Maximum number of triggers firing concurrently

crash_recovery.description: Whether to recover trigger state after a crash

trigger_off_override.description: When true, the --trigger-off flag disables all triggers
